name: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk
summary: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk, through its subsidiaries, engages in the media, healthcare, aviation support services, digital products and services, and other businesses in Indonesia. The company's Media segment is involved in the free-to-air television broadcasting business through six television channels, as well as content, film and video production and distribution, and digital businesses. This segment also engages in the subscription broadcasting of satellite television under PT Mediatama Televisi. The company's Healthcare segment offers a range of medical services.
